sourceNotes.note: Sam Darnold quadriceps update: expected back after Week 11 bye per HC Macdonald.
Jaxon Smith-Njigba 51 yards snapped 13-game 70+ yard streak; context on recent production.
Corroboration on Cardinals signing Josh Johnson with Minshew out; Bills LT inactive.

items.text: The Seahawks believe Sam Darnold (quadriceps) will be ready to return following the team's Week 11 bye, per head coach Mike Macdonald.
items.why: HC Mike Macdonald indicates Darnold (quad) ready after Week 11 bye.
items.implication: SEA QB depth; Darnold available as backup/stream post-bye for JD.
items.opportunity: Potential start or depth if Geno struggles or bye coverage.

items.text: Jaxon Smith-Njigba had 51 receiving yards on Sunday. That snapped a streak of 13 straight games with 70+ yards, tied for the 4th-longest since 1999. He's been held under 70 yards only twice in his last 26 games.
items.why: Post-game yards total ends long high-volume streak; context on consistency.
items.implication: Slight volume variance but still elite WR1 floor/ceiling for JD starter.
items.opportunity: Continue starting; monitor targets/routes next week.
